notes.title: April Recap – A Big Month for Bullet Noir
notes.content:
April marked a major milestone for Bullet Noir and our team at Wolcen Studio. With the Early Access release and a series of exciting events, we’ve been thrilled to see the game land in players’ hands and watch the action unfold.

Here’s a look back at everything that happened in April:

🎮 Early Access Launch
Bullet Noir officially launched in Early Access on Steam. Players now have access to a gritty twin-stick shooter set in a noir-drenched city, with four playable characters, tactical one-hit-one-kill combat, and unique ability-driven gameplay. Thank you to everyone who picked up the game, left feedback, or helped spread the word.

https://steamcommunity.com/games/3204960/announcements/detail/640181878351988027

🎁 Early Access Gleam Giveaway
To celebrate the launch, we ran a Gleam Giveaway where players could win free Steam keys for Bullet Noir. Thousands of entries came through and it was amazing to welcome so many new faces to the community. If this is how you found us, we’re glad to have you here.

Congratulations to the winners: 
🔹 MoKurr
🔹 Seingau96
🔹 Ofraysse
🔹 Julefar
🔹 MrAsian11


⏱️ Community Speedrun Event
We also hosted our first Speedrun Event and were blown away by the submissions. Players raced through the demo and pushed the limits of precision and speed. After reviewing the top runs, here are the winners:

https://steamcommunity.com/games/3204960/announcements/detail/640181878351988029

🥇 1st Place: Wolfye – 2:28.4
🥈 2nd Place: Andro Sphinx – 3:28.2

📺 You can check the winning runs
Wolfye: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sVQWFIZ7xrE
Andro Sphinx: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QLYy0KX76Tc

🛠️ Devlogs and Updates
We also kicked off our Developer Log series this month to share insights into how Bullet Noir is built and balanced.

Devlog #1 covered the core design philosophy and what makes Bullet Noir’s combat tick
https://steamcommunity.com/games/3204960/announcements/detail/521961040610590868

Devlog #2 explored the two game modes: Standard and Hardcore, and how they cater to different playstyles
https://steamcommunity.com/games/3204960/announcements/detail/521962942830215363

More devlogs are on the way soon.


That wraps up a huge first month for Bullet Noir. We’re already working on new updates, community features, and more events for May. Thanks again for being part of the journey and we’ll see you in the shadows.

🔗 Play Bullet Noir on Steam

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3204960/Bullet_Noir/

notes.title: Devlog #2: Choose Your Challenge: Standard vs. Hardcore Mode
notes.content:
Our second devlog dives into the two difficulty options available in Bullet Noir.

Standard Mode is for those who enjoy a challenge without the intensity turned up to 11. It’s tough, but with a bit of grit and determination, most players will be able to make it through.

Hardcore Mode, on the other hand, is for those seeking a brutal, unforgiving experience. Enemies hit harder, timing is tighter, and mistakes are deadly. Perfect for players who live for high-stakes action.

[previewyoutube=8Htfj-r0E_Q;full][/previewyoutube]

Whether you’re here to enjoy the story or test your reflexes and strategy, Bullet Noir gives you the freedom to choose how deep you want to go.

Put your skills to the test and compete for prizes by completing the demo in record time. Top placements and unlucky moments both have a shot at earning rewards!

notes.title: Bullet Noir launches April 15 + New Cinematic Trailer!
notes.content:
The wait is almost over! Bullet Noir, our gritty, hyper-stylized twin-stick shooter, is launching into Early Access on Steam on April 15th, 2025!

Watch the new Bullet Noir cinematic Early Access launch date trailer!

[previewyoutube=Imd5LkoKlqo;full][/previewyoutube]

Set in a rain-slicked, neo-noir cityscape, Bullet Noir follows four lost souls on a relentless quest for vengeance. 

As they scour the streets for their mentor’s killer, players will step into each character’s shoes, mastering their unique skills to overcome challenges and outsmart enemies in intense shootouts. 
Each of Bullet Noir’s four protagonists has distinct abilities, allowing players to approach combat differently.

As the first title in our Indie Initiative, Bullet Noir represents our commitment to fostering creativity and supporting smaller, passion-driven projects within Wolcen Studios. This initiative allows our developers to bring fresh, in-house ideas to life, all while continuing our work on larger projects like Project Pantheon.

“Bullet Noir is a love letter to the action and noir genres, drawing inspiration from classics like Hotline Miami, John Wick, Sin City, and The Matrix.”
We wanted to create something fierce, kinetic, and oozing with style—an action game that keeps you constantly making micro-decisions as you tackle chaotic, high-stakes scenarios.”
Tavi Petre, Game Director

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45198025/2d9ce4358e807095efc612922efabf797f9f8d52.gif

With a rich, intertwining story, dynamic playstyles, and intense, stylish shootouts, Bullet Noir is designed to be an unforgettable experience.

“At Wolcen, we encourage our team to explore their creative ambitions. Bullet Noir is the first step in our Indie Initiative, proving that smaller, passionate teams can thrive alongside larger-scale productions. We’re excited to see how this new approach fuels innovation and brings unique experiences to players.”
Bogdan Oprescu, President of Wolcen Studios

The streets of Bullet Noir are waiting. Wishlist now and prepare to step into the shadows when Early Access launches on April 15th!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45198025/0b2cceeab9cf7ff35dcc7648e9fe577a1c101180.png

notes.title: Bullet Noir - Announcement + Teaser
notes.content:
This Is Bullet Noir – Wolcen Studio's First Indie Title! 

Amid a turbulent gaming industry, we at Wolcen Studio choose a different path. We stand by our team, fostering their creativity and fueling their passion to bring indie games to life—projects they truly believe in.

Bullet Noir is the first release under our Indie Initiative, a program designed to uplift smaller, passion-driven projects. This initiative not only keeps creativity alive but also strengthens our commitment to both our developers and you, our community.

While working on the Early Access version of Bullet Noir, we also concluded recently that we want to take the reins into our own hands and self-publish the game.

Therefore, we invite you to step into the shadows and unleash a storm of bullets in a noir-inspired adventure. Don't miss Bullet Noir's demo, which is already live on Steam!
